name: Kyougo Nagi
source:
He's curt and shy but despite that he's a helpful person, the protagonist's childhood friend.
Using his natural good reflexes he works as a bodyguard.
He tended to be teased a lot as a child, so he always stayed by the protagonist's side.

For a certain reason he finds it distasteful to trade time, so he doesn't use the BANK at all.
